[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Out of boundary paths** [LC 576 · Out of Boundary Paths](https://leetcode.com/problems/out-of-boundary-paths/){difficulty="Medium"}

Right then left returns to the start, so a table indexed only by the cell has no fill order and the count of walks is infinite. The move budget is what grows. After $t$ moves the ball is at one cell, still inside, or it has already left. Leaving is the event you add; staying is the mass you push into the next layer.

[Solved in full in @sec-gd-p3-out.]{.card-link}
